ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that points $C$, $D$, and $E$ lie on line $AB$, and point $D$ is the midpoint of segment $AC$, point $E$ is the midpoint of segment $DB$. If point $C$ is on segment $EB$ and $DB=6$, $CE=1$, what is the length of segment $AB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since point $E$ is the midpoint of line segment $DB$ and $DB=6$,\\
it follows that $DE=\frac{1}{2}DB=\frac{1}{2}\times 6=3$,\\
since $EC=1$,\\
then $DC=DE+EC=3+1=4$,\\
since point $D$ is the midpoint of line segment $AC$,\\
it follows that $AD=DC=4$,\\
therefore $AB=AD+DB=4+6=\boxed{10}$.
